[dependencies]
# The patched 4.1 backport preserves the workspace's Rust 1.82 MSRV.

sha2 = "0.10.9"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["io-util", "macros", "net", "rt-multi-thread", "signal", "sync", "time"] }
walkdir = "2"
yaml_serde = "0.10"
